# Pulumi ComponentResource: S3 + RDS + IAM

## Structure

```
infra/
├── Pulumi.yaml
├── components/
│   ├── __init__.py
│   └── web_infra.py
├── __main__.py
├── Pulumi.dev.yaml
└── Pulumi.prod.yaml
```

## `Pulumi.yaml`

```yaml
name: web-app-infra
runtime: python
description: Stateless web app infrastructure
```

## Stack configs

**`Pulumi.dev.yaml`**

```yaml
config:
  web-app-infra:environment: dev
  web-app-infra:region: us-east-1
  web-app-infra:db_instance_class: db.t3.micro
  web-app-infra:db_multi_az: false
  web-app-infra:db_allocated_storage: "20"
  web-app-infra:db_password:
    secure: AAABAJc0eH...   # encrypted with stack key
  web-app-infra:oidc_provider_arn: ""
```

**`Pulumi.prod.yaml`**

```yaml
config:
  web-app-infra:environment: prod
  web-app-infra:region: us-east-1
  web-app-infra:db_instance_class: db.t3.medium
  web-app-infra:db_multi_az: true
  web-app-infra:db_allocated_storage: "50"
  web-app-infra:db_password:
    secure: AAABAL9xkP...
  web-app-infra:oidc_provider_arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/id/EXAMPLE
```

## `components/web_infra.py`

```python
import pulumi
import pulumi_aws as aws


class WebInfra(pulumi.ComponentResource):
    """Wraps S3 bucket, RDS PostgreSQL, and IAM role for service accounts."""

    def __init__(self, name: str, opts: pulumi.ResourceOptions = None):
        cfg = pulumi.Config()
        env = cfg.require("environment")

        super().__init__("webapp:infra:WebInfra", name, None, opts)

        # --- S3 bucket ---
        bucket = aws.s3.BucketV2(
            f"{name}-{env}-assets",
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
        )
        aws.s3.BucketVersioningV2(
            f"{name}-{env}-versioning",
            bucket=bucket.bucket,
            versioning_configuration=aws.s3.BucketVersioningV2VersioningConfigurationArgs(
                status="Enabled",
            ),
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
        )
        aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationV2(
            f"{name}-{env}-sse",
            bucket=bucket.bucket,
            rules=[aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationV2RuleArgs(
                apply_server_side_encryption_by_default=aws.s3.BucketServerSideEncryptionConfigurationV2RuleApplyServerSideEncryptionByDefaultArgs(
                    sse_algorithm="aws:kms",
                    kms_master_key_id=aws.kms.Key(
                        f"{name}-{env}-key",
                        description=f"Asset key for {env}",
                        deletion_window_in_days=7,
                        opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
                    ).arn,
                ),
                bucket_key_enabled=True,
            )],
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
        )
        aws.s3.BucketPublicAccessBlock(
            f"{name}-{env}-pab",
            bucket=bucket.bucket,
            block_public_acls=True,
            block_public_policy=True,
            ignore_public_acls=True,
            restrict_public_buckets=True,
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
        )

        # --- RDS PostgreSQL ---
        db_subnet = aws.rds.SubnetGroup(
            f"{name}-{env}-db-subnets",
            subnet_ids=aws.ec2.get_subnets(
                filters=[{"name": "vpc-id", "values": [self._default_vpc()]}],
            ).then(lambda s: s.ids),
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
        )
        db_password = cfg.require_secret("db_password")
        db = aws.rds.Instance(
            f"{name}-{env}-db",
            engine="postgres",
            engine_version="15",
            instance_class=cfg.require("db_instance_class"),
            allocated_storage=cfg.get_float("db_allocated_storage", 20),
            db_name="webapp",
            username="webapp_admin",
            password=db_password,
            db_subnet_group_name=db_subnet.name,
            multi_az=cfg.get_bool("db_multi_az", False),
            deletion_protection=True,
            publicly_accessible=False,
            backup_retention_period=7,
            storage_encrypted=True,
            skip_final_snapshot=False,
            final_snapshot_identifier=f"{name}-{env}-final",
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
        )

        # --- IAM role for service accounts ---
        oidc_arn = cfg.get("oidc_provider_arn")
        assume_policy = self._trust_policy(oidc_arn) if oidc_arn else {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [{
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": {"Service": "ec2.amazonaws.com"},
                "Action": "sts:AssumeRole",
            }],
        }
        role = aws.iam.Role(
            f"{name}-{env}-svc-role",
            assume_role_policy=json.dumps(assume_policy),
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
        )
        aws.iam.RolePolicy(
            f"{name}-{env}-svc-policy",
            role=role.name,
            policy=bucket.bucket.apply(lambda b: json.dumps({
                "Version": "2012-10-17",
                "Statement": [{
                    "Effect": "Allow",
                    "Action": ["s3:GetObject", "s3:PutObject", "s3:ListBucket"],
                    # No wildcards: scoped to bucket + bucket objects
                    "Resource": [f"arn:aws:s3:::{b}", f"arn:aws:s3:::{b}/*"],
                }],
            })),
            opts=pulumi.ResourceOptions(parent=self),
        )

        # Exported outputs
        self.bucket_name = bucket.bucket
        self.db_endpoint = db.address
        self.role_arn = role.arn
        self.register_outputs({
            "bucket_name": bucket.bucket,
            "db_endpoint": db.address,
            "role_arn": role.arn,
        })

    @staticmethod
    def _default_vpc() -> str:
        return aws.ec2.get_vpc(default=True, tags={}).id

    @staticmethod
    def _trust_policy(provider_arn: str) -> dict:
        host = provider_arn.split("/")[-1]
        return {
            "Version": "2012-10-17",
            "Statement": [{
                "Effect": "Allow",
                "Principal": {"Federated": provider_arn},
                "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                "Condition": {"StringEquals": {
                    f"{host}:sub": "system:serviceaccount:webapp:webapp",
                }},
            }],
        }
```

## `__main__.py`

```python
import pulumi
from components.web_infra import WebInfra

infra = WebInfra("webapp")

pulumi.export("assets_bucket", infra.bucket_name)
pulumi.export("db_endpoint", infra.db_endpoint)
pulumi.export("service_role_arn", infra.role_arn)
```

## Usage

```bash
pulumi stack init dev
pulumi config set --secret db_password '...'   # stored encrypted
pulumi up

pulumi stack init prod
pulumi config set db_instance_class db.t3.medium
pulumi config set db_multi_az true
pulumi config set --secret db_password '...'
pulumi up
```

## Acceptance criteria mapping

| Criterion | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Bucket versioning + SSE, no public access | `BucketVersioningV2`, KMS SSE + bucket key, full `BucketPublicAccessBlock` |
| RDS deletion protection, backups ≥7d, not public | `deletion_protection=True`, `backup_retention_period=7`, `publicly_accessible=False` |
| Secret not in plaintext | `require_secret` → stored encrypted in state via stack key |
| Least privilege IAM | No wildcards; actions scoped to specific bucket; OIDC-federated trust in prod |
| Env isolation | Separate stacks (`dev`/`prod`), each with own config & state |
